title: Uttar Pradesh UP DGMHUP ANM Training Program Admissions 2026 Selected Candidate List
organization: Uttar Pradesh Department of Medical Health & Family Welfare
postName: UP DGMHUP ANM Training Admission 2026 Selected Candidate List
vacancyDetails: 1800 ANM training seats across government training centres in Uttar Pradesh.
qualification: Only female candidates. Intermediate / 10+2 from a recognized board with 45% marks for General / OBC / EWS and 40% marks for SC / ST candidates.
ageLimit: 17 to 35 years as on 31/12/2025. Relaxation as per UP ANM Training admission rules.
applicationFee: General: 200/-. OBC / SC / ST: 100/-. Pay through UPI, debit card, credit card or net banking.
selectionProcess: Online application → Merit / selected candidate list → Document verification → ANM training admission
documentsRequired: Application details, educational certificates, identity proof, photograph, signature and category documents where applicable.
howToApply:
1. Open the selected candidate list PDF.
2. Search your registration or candidate details in the list.
3. Follow DGMHUP instructions for document verification and admission.
4. Use the official portal for further updates.
shortDescription: UP DGMHUP ANM Training Admission 2026 selected candidate list released on 18 September 2026. Download the shortlist PDF and check admission instructions.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Department of Medical Health & Family Welfare has released the UP DGMHUP ANM Training Program Admissions 2026 Selected Candidate List.

Candidates who applied for the UP ANM Training Programme can download the shortlisted candidate list and follow the instructions for document verification and admission.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 01/07/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 31/07/2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date: 31/07/2026
  • Selected Candidate / Merit List: 18/09/2026

Admission Details

  • Course: Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM) Training
  • Total Seats: 1800
  • Eligibility: Female candidates with Intermediate qualification
importantInstructions: Download the selected candidate list from the official DGMHUP training portal and follow the document verification and admission instructions.

faqs.question: When was the UP DGMHUP ANM selected candidate list released?
faqs.answer: The selected candidate list was released on 18 September 2026.

faqs.question: How can candidates download the list?
faqs.answer: Open the Download Selected Candidate List link in the Important Links section and search your candidate details in the PDF.
